expectation: Myeloid CD33: membrane ring on a subset of cells (monocytes/macrophages, myeloid cells, some DCs). Scattered single cells or clusters, mostly in stroma or immune infiltrates, with other cells negative. Intensity should differ between cells.
observed: A: signal varies hugely by image. Some tiles are broadly yellow, with large diffuse patches and streaks, while others are mostly dark with sparse specks. B and C: diffuse haze and grain over the tissue, with a few small bright foci and no ring-shaped cells. D: yellow smear across cells, with no membrane outlines.
why: Signal is diffuse haze that follows tissue texture and differs between tiles, with no discrete membrane-stained cell subset.
notes: Yellow is broad haze and grain that tracks tissue density and tile, not a distinct cell population. B, C and D show no membrane rings or clustered myeloid cells; the few bright specks look like debris.
